summary.result: Finally it was concluded that, to improve the simulation results by the model, a new attempt to develop a fully nonlinear model as well as further calibration and the more reasonable generation of finite element grid would be needed.
summary.background: The TIDE, finite element model for the simulation of tidal flow in shallow sea was tested for its applicability at the Saemangeum area.
